d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Nigerian billionaire and Africa’s richest man, Aliko Dangote, has announced plans to pour massive investments into Ghana’s agricultural sector, targeting sugar, cocoa, and rice production. Speaking at the inaugural Invest Ghana Summit, Dangote revealed deep personal ties to the country—noting that a quarter of his family was born there—while outlining a joint venture with the Ghanaian government. The centrepiece is a major sugar project in the Bono East region projected to create nearly 50,000 jobs, alongside plans with COCOBOD to transform Ghana…
